summary: Ran 7 backend pytest tests (all pass) and Playwright UI tests. Backend APIs (auth, CRUD, CSV import, auth protection) all work correctly. Frontend login, dashboard load, seeded product listing with ₺ formatting, search, add/edit/delete, select-all checkbox, and CSV import UI all work. However a CRITICAL bug breaks per-row selection and bulk label printing: backend returns product id as '_id' (Pydantic Field alias), but Dashboard.js uses p.id everywhere. Result: all rows get data-testid='product-row-undefined' (duplicate React keys warning), toggleOne uses undefined key, buildPrintItems() finds nothing so PrintPreview never opens.

minor.issue: Pydantic Field(alias='_id') combined with FastAPI default response_model_by_alias=True causes response JSON to expose '_id' instead of 'id'. Frontend expects 'id'. Either serialize by field name (response_model_by_alias=False) or return dict with 'id' key, OR update frontend to use _id. Since serialize_product() already returns a plain dict, the Product response_model wraps it and re-serializes with alias.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses p.id everywhere (data-testid=`product-row-${p.id}`, select-checkbox-${p.id}, qty-input-${p.id}, edit-button-${p.id}, delete-button-${p.id}, selected[p.id], toggleOne(p.id), key={p.id}). But API returns _id, so p.id is undefined for all rows. Causes: (a) React key warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' visible in console, (b) individual row checkbox clicks toggle selected[undefined] so 1st click selects, 2nd click deselects, and every row shares the same isSel state, (c) 'Seçili Ürün' count reads Object.keys(selected).length so may show 1 not the true count, (d) buildPrintItems() calls products.find(x => x.id === id) which never matches (products have _id only), so Print preview never opens even when items appear selected — clicking 'Tam Etiket'/'Yarım Etiket' with selection either shows the 'lütfen en az bir ürün seçin' toast or opens an empty preview.

integration_issues.issue: Print preview never opens with selected rows because of the p.id vs _id mismatch. Full end-to-end bulk-print (core requirement) is currently broken.
qty-input-<id> selectors resolve to qty-input-undefined; multiple duplicates render only after select-all mass-toggle.

action_items: Fix Product id serialization: quickest fix is to change Product model to `id: str` (no alias) and have serialize_product() return {'id': str(doc['_id']), ...} instead of '_id'. Then update Dashboard.js delete/edit which currently use editing?._id / deleteTarget._id to use .id (and everywhere else the code already uses .id). Alternative: keep _id in payload and change Dashboard.js to use p._id / editing?._id consistently and update all data-testids and helpers.

After fix, re-verify: individual checkbox selection updates 'Seçili Ürün' count, qty-input-<id> renders per selected row, bulk print Tam/Yarım opens PrintPreview with correct number of labels (sum of qty).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py: Product response_model uses Field(alias='_id') with default by_alias=True — this leaks Mongo-style _id into API and breaks the frontend contract. Prefer returning 'id' as a plain string.
Frontend Dashboard.js key={editing?._id || 'new'} on ProductDialog: mixes _id (works today) with p.id (undefined) — inconsistent id handling across the file.
server.py: startup uses @app.on_event('startup') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers.
CORS: allow_credentials=True with wildcard-like list is fine here since specific origins are set, but CORS_ORIGINS env variable defined in .env is unused.

success_rate.frontend: ~60% — login/list/search/add/edit/delete/select-all/CSV work; per-row selection and bulk print broken

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 Turkish products on startup if empty; tests create/delete TEST_-prefixed products and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Root cause of broken bulk print is p.id vs _id mismatch. Once E1 fixes id field to be plain 'id' in API response (or updates frontend to use _id everywhere including in filter/toggle helpers and testids), rerun the Playwright flow: login → click 2 checkboxes → confirm 'Seçili Ürün' shows 2 and 2 qty-input-<id> appear → set qty=3 on first → click print-full-button → expect do-print-button + 4 print-label divs (3+1) → close → click print-half-button → expect labels visible. Backend tests already cover 401 without token, login success/fail, CRUD, CSV import.
rca of the issue: Backend Pydantic Product model declares `id: PyObjectId = Field(alias='_id')`. FastAPI serializes response_model with by_alias=True by default so the JSON payload uses '_id'. The React Dashboard was written expecting `p.id` and uses it for selection state keys, data-testid values, and product lookup in buildPrintItems. Consequence: all products get identical undefined id in the frontend, breaking selection & bulk print. Reproduction: login, click any individual product's checkbox — 'Seçili Ürün' stat still shows 0 and no qty input appears. Mitigation: change Product model to expose 'id' (not aliased), OR use response_model_by_alias=False, OR update the frontend to consistently reference _id.
